A massacre that began with two killings
2021-12-18T23:08:45+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/massacre-began-two-killings-2920471

April 2, 1971. There was curfew all over the country. By 11:30 pm, a military jeep arrived at Suresh Kumar Pande's place in Rajshahi. Suresh came out hearing knocks on the door. A Pakistani soldier shot him while leaving after the conversation. Suresh was martyred.

The Pakistani army also killed Birendranath Sarkar, a lawyer, the same way that night -- starting a massacre in Rajshahi.

During 50th anniversary of Bangladesh's independence, Star Special recounts the story of genocide in Rajshahi.
